title: Choose how much to delegate.
lead: An illustrative decision aid: combine the impact of a mistake with how easily an action can be reversed.

children.x: IMPACT OF A MISTAKE: LOW → HIGH

cells.title: Let it run
cells.body: Low impact · easy to undo. Draft a label or reorder a local list.

cells.title: Preview, then approve
cells.body: High impact · easy to undo. Inspect a proposed access change.

cells.title: Keep a checkpoint
cells.body: Low impact · hard to undo. Save the source before a cleanup.

cells.title: Keep a human decision
cells.body: High impact · hard to undo. Review a consequential publication.

children.content: Classify the action in its actual context. The same tool can belong in different cells.
